Earth Elementals are a type of Elemental creature that can be summoned via the spell  Conjure Elemental.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Soil-Clogged Slam ()
Damage: 8~18
2d6 + 6⁠Bludgeoning
Punch a foe with a landslide's worth of force, leaving behind a residue of mud.
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Seismic Strike ()
Damage: 4~24
4d6⁠Bludgeoning
Bring down your arms like stone slabs, smashing nearby creatures, pushing them back 3m / 10ft, and making them wobble on  Trembling Legs. Note that this can also harm your own party members.
 DEX Save
 Range: Self
 Multiattack ()
Damage: 14~26
2d4 + 5⁠Bludgeoning
+ 2d4 + 5⁠Bludgeoning

Descend on a creature to smash it with your tectonic might.

 Prone targets take double damage.

 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Recharge: Per turn
 Elemental Warp ()

Surrounded by silver mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
